title: CAREamics denoising pipeline parameters
description: Example Nextflow pipeline for training or applying CAREamics denoising models.

prediction_csv.description: CSV file with prediction samples. Must contain an image column with the image path or zarr store root. May contain sample and inner_zarr_path columns.

pretrained_model.description: Path to a pretrained CAREamics checkpoint. If provided, training is skipped.

train_data.description: Training data as a .tif, .tiff, or .czi file, .zarr store, or directory containing image files. Required when pretrained_model is not provided.

train_inner_zarr_path.description: Optional relative inner path to a zarr group within train_data. When set, CAREamics receives file://train_data/train_inner_zarr_path while the full zarr store is staged.

target_data.description: Paired target data as a .tif, .tiff, or .czi file, .zarr store, or directory containing image files. Required for care and n2n training.

train_target_inner_zarr_path.description: Optional relative inner path to a zarr group within target_data. When set, CAREamics receives file://train_target/train_target_inner_zarr_path while the full zarr store is staged.

val_data.description: Optional validation data as a .tif, .tiff, or .czi file, .zarr store, or directory containing image files.

val_inner_zarr_path.description: Optional relative inner path to a zarr group within val_data. Requires val_data.

val_target.description: Optional paired validation target data as a .tif, .tiff, or .czi file, .zarr store, or directory containing image files. Required with val_data for care and n2n training.

val_target_inner_zarr_path.description: Optional relative inner path to a zarr group within val_target. Requires val_target.

experiment_name.description: Name used by CAREamics for the training experiment.

data_type.description: Input data type passed to CAREamics.

axes.description: Axes for training data, for example SYX.

pred_axes.description: Axes for prediction data, for example YX.

patch_size.description: Training patch size, passed as a space-separated list, for example '64 64'.

tile_size.description: Prediction tile size, passed as a space-separated list, for example '256 256'.

tile_overlap.description: Prediction tile overlap, passed as a space-separated list, for example '48 48'.

batch_size.description: Batch size used for training and prediction.

num_steps.description: Number of training steps. If omitted, CAREamics uses its default behavior.

use_n2v2.description: Enable N2V2 when training the n2v algorithm.

n_channels.description: Number of channels for N2V training.

n_channels_in.description: Number of input channels for CARE/N2N training.

n_channels_out.description: Number of output channels for CARE/N2N training.
